name: Aqua Beads

features.text: A highly concentrated rinse and spray wax for car wash tunnels.
Enhances gloss and sheds water from exterior.
Can be diluted and applied with a spray bottle.

description: A concentrated car-wash rinse aide that promotes sheeting action, increased drying efficiency and a gloss finish. Designed for use in automatic car-wash machines, pressure washers, or hand application to create spot-free rinse.
application: DIRECTIONS: 1) MACHINE USE: Dilute product with water according to chart below. Follow machine manufacturer’s directions for application. 2) HAND USE: Dilute product with water according to chart below. Spray diluted solution on vehicle exterior using a trigger sprayer. TYPICAL DILUTION RATIOS WITH WATER: Premium Dilution 40-60 parts water to 1 part product. Regular Dilution 61-80 parts water to 1 part product. Economy Dilution 81-100 parts water to 1 part product.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 2 Concentration - 10
